rolesGrid.helpView: What each team role can do.

rolesGrid.needOne: {{name}} needs at least one ticked box.
rolesGrid.confirmText: They apply at once to everyone in these roles.
rolesGrid.saved: Saved. Everyone in these roles has the new access now.
rolesGrid.handPickedNote: Columns marked "hand-picked" are staff with no team role, whose permissions were chosen one by one. To change them, use "Change" on that person's row above.

dashboard.empty: No permissions have been given to you yet. Ask an AYWO Admin.
dashboard.twoStepTitle: Turn on your second sign-in step

users.title: Users

users.search: Name, id, email or full phone number
users.name: Name
users.blockText: This signs the account out everywhere and stops new sign-ins.
users.unblockText: This account will be able to sign in again.

trees.search: Tree name or the Creator's name
trees.name: Tree
trees.creator: Creator
trees.askText: You will see names only, never contact details. Your name and reason go in the audit log.
trees.lookRecorded: Recorded in the audit log. Reason: {{reason}}

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: New relationship words and reports of wrong words.
dictionary.approveText: It joins the dictionary for everyone.
dictionary.rejectText: It stays out of the dictionary.
dictionary.acceptText: With a corrected word below, the word is replaced and marked verified. With the box empty, the word is withdrawn.
dictionary.correctedNative: Corrected word, in its own script
dictionary.dismissText: The word stays as it is.
dictionary.takeBackTitle: Take "{{word}}" back out of the dictionary?
dictionary.takeBackText: It was approved, and people see it now. Taking it back removes it from the dictionary for everyone. You can approve it again from the Rejected list.
dictionary.searchingFor: Showing words that match "{{q}}". Search with an empty box to see all.
dictionary.correctText: The word stays approved. Everyone sees the new spelling at once.
dictionary.approveFixText: It joins the dictionary for everyone. If the spelling has a small mistake, put it right here before you approve.
dictionary.wordNativeHelp: Leave empty if there is none.
dictionary.willSaveCorrected: The word will be saved with your spelling.
dictionary.decidedHelp: Reports already decided, the newest first. The word is shown as it reads now.
dictionary.noDecided: No reports have been decided yet.

takedowns.title: Takedown requests
takedowns.subtitle: People asking to be removed from a tree someone else made.
takedowns.noPersonLinked: Not linked to a tree yet
takedowns.askedBy: How to reach the person asking
takedowns.note: Your note (recorded in the audit log)
takedowns.removeText: This person disappears from the tree, their contact details are deleted, and the tree's Creator is told. It can't be brought back from history.
takedowns.dismissText: Nothing changes in the tree. Reply to the person asking yourself.
takedowns.searchHelp: Type at least 2 letters of the name, then press Search.
takedowns.noMatch: Nobody with that name is in any tree. Try a shorter or different spelling.
takedowns.tooMany: Only the first 20 are shown. Type more of the name to narrow it down.
takedowns.needPerson: Still needed: pick which person to remove.
takedowns.reopenText: For a request dismissed by mistake. It goes back to Open and into the work queue, due in 72 hours. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
takedowns.reopened: The request is open again. You will find it under Open and in the work queue.
takedowns.finalRemoved: Final: the person was removed from the tree and can't be brought back.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Plans and payments. Order refunds are on the Orders page; plan refunds happen at the store or gateway.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: AYWO's own team. This has nothing to do with a tree's Creator.
staff.name: Name
staff.addText: Type the person's mobile number. If they already use AYWO they become staff now. If the number has never signed in, an invite waits for its first sign-in, for 14 days. To add back someone you removed, use "Removed from staff" below: no number needed.
staff.removeText: The account stays. Its staff access ends at once.
staff.adminHelp: An AYWO Admin can do everything, including managing staff and reading the audit log.
staff.teamRolesHelp: A team role is a named set of permissions. Changing a role changes everyone in it.
staff.resetText: They are signed out and must set up their authenticator app again at the next sign-in.
staff.invitedText: AYWO does not send this person any message. Please tell them yourself: sign in to AYWO with this number within 14 days, then open the admin page. They become staff at that first sign-in.
staff.roleChangesAll_one: {{count}} person has this role. Changes apply to them at once.
staff.roleChangesAll_other: {{count}} people have this role. Changes apply to them at once.
staff.cancelInviteText: This number will not become staff when it signs in. You can add it again later.
staff.needPhone: Type the full phone number with its country code.
staff.needPermission: Tick at least one permission, or choose a team role.
staff.promoteText: {{name}} will be able to do everything in this panel: add and remove staff and other AYWO Admins, change anyone's permissions, read the audit log, block accounts, refund orders, change app settings, and send notices to every member.
staff.promoteWarn: Give this only to someone who runs AYWO with you. Another AYWO Admin can take it away later.
staff.needRoleName: Type a role name of at least 2 letters.
staff.needRolePermission: Tick at least one permission for this role.
staff.deleteRoleText: Nobody has this role now. Once deleted it can't be brought back; you would have to make it again.
staff.deleteRoleBlocked: This role can be deleted only when nobody has it. Move its people to another role first.
staff.invitesHelp: AYWO sends no message for an invite. Tell the person to sign in with that number.
staff.changeInviteText: Saving also renews the invite for another 14 days.
staff.formerHelp: Add someone back with the role they had. No phone number to type. For safety they set up their second step again.
staff.addPersonText: This account already uses AYWO, so no phone number is needed. Choose what they can do.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every staff action. Nobody can change or delete this record.
audit.search: Search: an action (removed staff), a staff name, or a reason

actions.takedown_removed: Removed a person after a takedown
actions.ticket_answered_closed: Answered and closed a help ticket
actions.takedown_person_search: Searched for a person for a takedown
actions.ticket_closed: Closed a help ticket without an answer
actions.order_step_undone: Took an order one step back

broadcast.title: System notices
broadcast.subtitle: For things every member must know, such as planned downtime or a change in terms. Never for marketing.
broadcast.heading: Heading
broadcast.confirmText: It goes to every account by push and email, and it can't be taken back. The reason you write is kept in the audit log.
broadcast.limitNote: It goes to every member at once and cannot be taken back. At most 3 notices can be sent in a day.
broadcast.usedToday: {{used}} of the {{limit}} notices allowed in 24 hours have already been sent.
broadcast.usedUp: All {{limit}} notices allowed in 24 hours have been sent. Please wait before sending another.
broadcast.noHistory: No notice has been sent yet.

twoStep.codeText: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for AYWO staff. You'll be asked again in 12 hours.
twoStep.lost: Lost your phone? Ask an AYWO Admin to reset your second step.
twoStep.setupText: Staff accounts can see private data, so they need a second step: a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoStep.step1: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account with this setup key:
twoStep.step2: 2. Type the 6-digit code the app shows:
twoStep.againText: Your 12-hour staff sign-in has ended. Type a new 6-digit code from your authenticator app to carry on. The page underneath, and anything you typed on it, is still there.
twoStep.needsCode: Type all 6 digits of the code.
twoStep.qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
twoStep.orKey: Scan the square with your authenticator app. Or type this key into it:

work.title: Work queue
work.subtitle: Everything waiting for staff, in one place. Give each item an owner, keep it moving, and finish before the deadline.
work.goTo: Go to the page to decide
work.noteHelp: Staff only. The person never sees this.
work.noteFirst: Add your note, or clear it, before leaving this item.
work.needNote: Write a note to add it.
work.doneHelp: "Done" only ticks this off the work queue. The ticket, report or request itself is answered on its own page: use "Go to the page to decide". Deciding it there marks this done by itself.

reports.title: Abuse reports
reports.subtitle: What people reported about memories, comments, chat messages and accounts. Decide each within 24 hours.
reports.removeText: It disappears for everyone. Every open report about it closes, and the people who reported it are told action was taken.
reports.removeProfileText: The account is blocked: signed out everywhere and unable to sign in.
reports.dismissText: Nothing changes. The person who reported it is told it was looked at.
reports.reopenText: For a "Keep it" pressed by mistake. The report goes back to Open and into the work queue, due in 24 hours. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
reports.reopened: The report is open again. You will find it under Open and in the work queue.
reports.finalRemoved: Final: the content was removed and can't be put back from here.

tickets.title: Help tickets
tickets.subtitle: Questions from the app's help centre. Your answers show as "AYWO Support", never your own name.
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.replyHelp: The person gets a notification and reads it in the app.
tickets.isClosed: This ticket is closed. A reply from the person opens it again, or reopen it yourself to answer.
tickets.searching: Showing tickets that match "{{q}}". Search with the box empty to see every ticket again.
tickets.emptySearch: No tickets match your search here. Try "All", or fewer letters.
tickets.answerFirst: Send your answer, or clear it, before leaving this ticket.
tickets.closeOnlySure: Close this ticket without an answer? The person gets no message. If they write again, it opens again.
tickets.closeOnlyBlocked: You have written an answer: use "Send and close", or clear it first.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Posters and books from paid to delivered. The buyer is told at each step.
orders.search: Buyer's name or phone, city, order number, tracking number or payment reference
orders.cancelText: The buyer gets a notification that the order is cancelled.
orders.refundText: The money goes back through Razorpay or Stripe to the way the buyer paid. This can't be undone.
orders.addressText: Write why you need the address. It's recorded in the audit log.
orders.noAddress: This order has no shipping address.
orders.stepDone: Saved. The order is now: {{step}}. The buyer has been told.
orders.cancelNoRefund: Cancelling does not give the money back. The buyer paid {{amount}}, and it stays paid until someone refunds it.
orders.cancelThenRefund: After you cancel, you will be asked whether to refund it straight away.
orders.cancelRefundElsewhere: This payment can't be refunded from here. After you cancel, refund it at the payment provider.
orders.cancelNeedsPayments: You don't have the Payments permission, so you can't refund. After you cancel, ask someone who has it to refund this order. It stays in the Cancelled list marked "Paid, not refunded".
orders.cancelDoneNoRefund: The order is cancelled and the buyer has been told. It has not been refunded: find it under Cancelled, marked "Paid, not refunded".
orders.refundAfterCancelText: The order is cancelled, but the buyer has not got the money back yet. Refund it now? The money goes back through Razorpay or Stripe to the way the buyer paid. This can't be undone.
orders.refundDone: Refunded {{amount}}. The buyer has been told.
orders.needTracking: Type the tracking number to mark it shipped.
orders.trackingUrlBad: The tracking link must start with https://
orders.correctTrackingText: For a tracking number or courier that was typed wrongly. The buyer is told the order changed and sees the new details. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
orders.trackingDone: Tracking details corrected. The buyer has been told.
orders.undoTitle: Take this order one step back?
orders.undoText: It goes from "{{from}}" back to "{{to}}". The buyer is told the order changed. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
orders.undoClearsTracking: The courier and tracking number are taken off the order, because it has not shipped. You type them again when you mark it shipped.
orders.undoDone: Done. The order is back at: {{step}}. The buyer has been told.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Coupons, scrolling banners and promotional messages.
offers.couponsHelp: Coupons work for posters, books and premium invites. Discounts on AYWO Plus inside the iPhone and Android apps must be Apple or Google offer codes, made in their own consoles.
offers.usedNote: This code has been used, so its code and discount stay fixed. You can still change the dates and limits, or switch it off.
offers.codeHelp: 4 to 20 letters and numbers, for example DIWALI20.
offers.newOnly: Only for a person's first order
offers.showInApp: Show on the Offers screen in the app

placementsHelp.app_banner: Scrolling strip at the top of the app
placementsHelp.web_banner: Scrolling strip on the public website

offers.bannersHelp: Short news or offers that scroll across the top of the app or the website. Keep the title under 60 letters.
offers.bannerTitleHelp: This scrolls. Example: Diwali offer: 20% off family posters
offers.linkHelp: An app page like /offers, or a full https link.
offers.linkLabel: Button word, for example See offer
offers.linkBad: The link must start with / or https://
offers.messagesHelp: A push notification to people who switched on offers and news in the app. At most two a day. Safety and service news go through System notices instead.
offers.willReach_one: Goes to {{count}} person. {{optedIn}} people have switched on offers.
offers.willReach_other: Goes to {{count}} people. {{optedIn}} people have switched on offers.
offers.sendText: It can't be taken back. Your reason goes in the audit log.
offers.dateBad: This isn't a real day. Type year-month-day, like {{example}}.
offers.endBeforeStart: The end day is before the start day.
offers.dateHelp: Starts at the beginning of this day, India time.
offers.endHelp: Runs until the end of this day, India time. Tap Clear for no end.
offers.percentBad: The percentage must be a whole number from 1 to 90.
offers.amountBad: The amount must be more than 0.
offers.perUserBad: Uses per person must be from 1 to 100.
offers.needCode: Type a code of at least 4 letters or numbers.
offers.needTitle: Type a title of at least 3 letters.
offers.needValue: Type how much the coupon takes off.
offers.needProduct: Tick at least one thing the coupon works on.
offers.reviewCouponText: This coupon is switched on, so it takes money off real orders. Please check it once more.
offers.warnNoEnd: No end day: this coupon keeps working until someone switches it off.
offers.warnEnded: The end day has already passed, so this will not show or work.
offers.warnNoLimit: No limit on total uses: any number of orders can use it.
offers.warnBigPercent: {{percent}}% off is a large discount. Make sure this is what you mean.
offers.needBannerText: Type the banner text, at least 3 letters.
offers.needPlacement: Tick at least one place for the banner to show.
offers.reviewBannerText: This banner is switched on, so the people below see it as soon as it starts. Please check it once more.
offers.warnBannerNoEnd: No end day: this banner keeps showing until someone switches it off.
offers.needHeading: Type a heading of at least 3 letters.
offers.needMessage: Type a message of at least 5 letters.
offers.opensBad: This must be an app page that starts with /, for example /offers.
offers.needCount: Send stays off until we can count who will get this. Press Try again above.
offers.nobodyToSend: Nobody in this group has switched on offers, so there is no one to send to. Choose a wider group.
offers.countFailed: We couldn't count who will get this. {{why}}
offers.pickPage: Or pick the page it opens:
offers.cantDeleteUsed: Used on an order, so it can't be deleted. It can only be switched off.
offers.deleteCouponText: Nobody has used this code. It is removed for good and stops working at once. This is recorded in the audit log.
offers.switchOffText: The code stops working at once. Orders already paid with it keep their discount. You can switch it on again with Change.
offers.deleteBannerText: It is removed for good, with its view counts. This is recorded in the audit log.
offers.deleteBannerRunningText: This banner is showing to people right now. Deleting it takes it off at once and removes it for good, with its view counts. This is recorded in the audit log.
offers.previewStrip: The strip at the top of the app or website
offers.previewStripNoBody: The strip shows the title and the button text only. The longer text shows on the Home card.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Counts only. No one's family details appear here.

settings.title: App settings
settings.subtitle: Changes reach every app within a minute, without a new release.

confirm.min_version: Phones on an older version must update before they can use AYWO.
confirm.latest_version: Phones on an older version see a gentle reminder to update.
confirm.maintenance: While maintenance is on, everyone except staff sees the message instead of the app.
confirm.features: Switched-off features disappear from the apps at once.
confirm.whats_new: People see this once after updating to this version.
confirm.support: Shown on the Contact and Help pages.

settings.versionsHelp: Below the minimum, the app stops and asks for an update. Below the latest, it suggests one.
settings.maintenanceHelp: For planned work. SOS alarms that are already running keep working.
settings.maintenanceSwitch: Show the maintenance message instead of the app
settings.maintenanceMessage: Message, for example Back at 6 pm
settings.featuresHelp: Turn a feature off quickly if it misbehaves.
settings.whatsNewHelp: Shown once to people after they update. One line per item, up to six.
settings.healthHelp: Crashes the apps reported. Numbers, emails and ids are removed before saving. Kept 30 days.
settings.missingRow: This setting is missing on the server, so it can't be saved from here. Please tell the technical team.
settings.saved: Saved. The apps pick it up within a minute.
settings.versionBad: Type a version as three numbers with dots, like 1.4.0.
settings.supportHelp: The email address and hours people see on the Contact and Help pages.
settings.supportHoursExample: For example Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 6 pm India time
settings.supportEmailBad: Type a full email address, like help@example.com.
settings.supportHoursBad: Type the hours when support answers.

user360.title: Account
user360.subtitle: Everything staff may see about one account. Family details stay private.
user360.askTitle: Why are you opening this account?
user360.askText: Your name and reason go in the audit log, and the account's history shows it. You are asked once for each account; the reason is reused until you close this browser tab.
user360.creator: Creator

confirm.minus: Take free Plus days back from {{name}}?

confirmText.block: Signed out everywhere, and new sign-ins stop.
confirmText.unblock: The account can sign in again.
confirmText.end: Every phone and browser is signed out. The account stays open.
confirmText.plus: Added on top of any free days they already have. They get a notification.
confirmText.minus: For days given by mistake. The days come off the free Plus this account has left, including days earned by inviting people. Asking for more than is left ends free Plus today, never earlier. A paid plan is not touched, and the person gets no notification.

user360.reloadFailed: Your change may be saved, but this page couldn't be reloaded, so it may show old details. {{why}}
user360.staffLocked: This is a staff account. Only an AYWO Admin can block it or sign it out everywhere.

done.minus: Free Plus days taken back from {{name}}.

user360.daysBad: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365.
user360.reasonKept: Opened for your reason: {{reason}}. Each time this page loads, a look is recorded with it.

funnel.title: Step by step: devices that first opened the app in the last {{count}} days
funnel.help: Anonymous: a random id per device, no names or numbers. Each step counts once per device.

funnel.biggestDrop: Most people stop before "{{step}}": {{count}} lost there.
funnel.splitLine: {{opened}} opened, {{verified}}% verified, {{tree}}% started a tree, {{five}}% reached 5 people

errors.admin_staff_only: Only an AYWO Admin can do this to staff.

errors.admin_cannot_change_self: You can't change your own staff place. Ask another AYWO Admin.
errors.admin_reason_required: Please write a reason of at least 5 characters.
errors.admin_user_not_found: No account found. The person must sign in to AYWO once first.

errors.admin_already_staff: This person is already on the staff.
errors.admin_permission_required: Choose at least one permission for a Sub-admin.
errors.admin_takedown_needs_person: Give the id of the person to remove. Find it on the Trees page.
errors.admin_audit_append_only: The audit log can't be changed.
errors.person_taken_down: This person was removed after a takedown request and can't be brought back.
errors.takedown_too_many: We've already received several requests from you. We'll reply soon.
errors.phone_invalid: That phone number doesn't look right. Include the country code.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.admin_broadcast_bad_text: A notice needs a heading of 3 to 80 letters and a message of 10 to 500.
errors.admin_broadcast_too_many: Three notices have gone out in the last day. Please wait before sending another.
errors.admin_two_step_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.admin_two_step_setup: Set up your second sign-in step first.
errors.admin_two_step_wrong: That code isn't right. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.

errors.admin_no_free_plus: This account has no free Plus days left to take back.
errors.coupon_used_no_delete: This code was used on an order, so it can't be deleted. Switch it off instead.

errors.kin_term_exists: That spelling is already in the dictionary for this relationship and language.
